Since pharmacotherapy is the primary seizure treat-
ment used today, identifying potential interactions of 
AEDs as well as nutrients is a critical component of 
nutritional care. Common issues include weight gain 
with valproate (Depakote®), carbamazepine (Tegretol®, 
Carbatrol®), and gabapentin (Neurontin®).Topiramate
(Topamax®) and zonisamide (Zonegran®) could cause 
weight loss as well as kidney stones (especially when
used concurrently with a ketogenic diet); adequate ﬂ uid 
intake is essential. Felbamate (Felbatol®) and carbam-
azepine (Tegretol®, Carbatrol®) should not be taken 
with grapefruit products.
